rows.Origin:
Bred by Bernard Sauvageot (France, 2006).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 2007 as 'Evelyne Dheliat'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow and pink. Strong fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Very large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Large buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, semi-glossy, light green foliage.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm). Width: up to 20" (up to 50cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
